messages:
maya: Quick pulse — RC build ready? Docs & sample app sync ok?
sam: Docs mostly done; two quick questions on snippet paths. pinging @lindsey for API surface confirmation.
lindsey: I can validate tonight. which snippet?
sam: In sdk/python/quickstart.md: import path is old. Should be `from redwood import Client` not `redwood_sdk`.
maya: Noted. ben, sample app ownership?
ben: Owning sample app. PR open: https://git.internal/redwood/devex/sample-app/pulls/421. Need a QA run on dedicated before we cut the changelog.
maya: Can QA run on dedicated tomorrow 9am PT? @ci-bot do we have a smoke env?
ci-bot: smoke cluster [redwood-devex-smoke] commissioned. use tag `devex-final` for PRs.
lindsey: API change is minor — backwards compatible. I'll add a note in changelog draft.
sam: Changelog cutoff is 48 hours before ship. We need approvals by Tue EOD.
maya: Ship target Wed Apr 12 10:00 PT. If any blockers by Tue noon ping here.
ben: merging sample app after green CI and one more doc tweak.
lindsey: I'll post final ack once I validate snippets.
maya: Great. I'll assemble release notes + owners list. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks all, will update PRs now.
ben: done — PR merged. QA scheduled for 2028-04-11 09:00 PT.
ci-bot: deploy started to smoke — logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/5557
maya: Thanks — I'll follow up with changelog draft in a few hours.
